title: Host hold record (F154-FR-041, F154-FR-044; data-model.md D9)
description: One quota hold of one harness account, with the reset time (F154-FR-041). PROPOSAL of spec 154. With `host.limits` on, a run that classifies a `quota_window` writes `<user-state>/holds/<account>.json` through `enterPause` (F127-FR-010 amended); before starting a pass, every run of the same account on the host reads it and waits until the reset through the same pause, the class `host_slot` (proposed in §C.13), which spends nothing. The record is a file in user-level state (F100 annex B row proposed), written by its holder's runtime root only, atomically, with an owner record and a liveness proof as the workspace lock has (F154-FR-044). No model is asked whether to wait (F154-FR-047).

account.description: The harness account the hold is for; one record per account.

harness.description: The harness of the account, read from the registry; no rule names a harness.

resetAt.description: When the provider's window resets; a run of the same account waits until then.

owner.description: The owner record of the lock: the run whose classification wrote the hold.
